How to use the roof pitch calculator

  1. Choose what you know: rise and run, the roof angle, or the building span with the pitch.
  2. Enter the values. Rise and run can be in any unit as long as both use the same one.
  3. For rafters, add the horizontal overhang. The rafter length includes the overhang along the slope.

Formula

Pitch = rise ÷ run × 12 (written x/12). Angle = arctan(rise ÷ run). Slope % = rise ÷ run × 100. Pitch multiplier = √(1 + (rise ÷ run)²). Rafter = (span ÷ 2) × multiplier + overhang × multiplier.

Example: a 6/12 roof has an angle of 26.57°, a slope of 50 % and a multiplier of 1.118. With a 24 ft span and 12 in overhang the rafter is 12 × 1.118 + 1 × 1.118 = 14.53 ft.

Tips

  • Most asphalt shingles need at least 2/12 (with extra underlayment) and normally 4/12 or steeper.
  • Rafter length here is measured along the top edge to the plumb cut; adjust for ridge board thickness.
  • Multiply the plan area of the roof by the pitch multiplier to get the actual roof surface area.

FAQ

What does 6/12 pitch mean?

The roof rises 6 units for every 12 units of horizontal run, which is an angle of 26.57°.

How do I convert pitch to degrees?

Angle = arctan(pitch ÷ 12). For 4/12 that is arctan(0.333) = 18.43°.

What is the pitch multiplier?

The factor that turns horizontal distance into length along the slope: √(1 + (pitch ÷ 12)²). For 6/12 it is 1.118.

What is a flat roof pitch?

A 0° angle is 0/12. Low-slope roofs below about 2/12 need membrane roofing instead of shingles.

Can I measure pitch from inside the attic?

Yes. Hold a level 12 in long against a rafter and measure straight up from the level to the rafter. That measurement is the rise per 12.
